import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int N, M, MOD;
    static int[] fac, inv, F, G;
    static int[][][] d1, d2;

    static void Fread(DataInputStream din, int[] x) {
        x[0] = 0;
        try {
            char c = (char) din.read();
            int sign = 1;
            while (c < '0' || c > '9') {
                if (c == '-') sign = -1;
                c = (char) din.read();
            }
            while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
                x[0] = (x[0] << 3) + (x[0] << 1) + (c - '0');
                c = (char) din.read();
            }
            x[0] *= sign;
        } catch (IOException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }

    static void Fout(int x) {
        if (x < 0) {
            System.out.print('-');
            x = -x;
        }
        if (x >= 10) Fout(x / 10);
        System.out.print(x % 10);
    }

    static int mod_add(int a, int b) {
        a += b;
        return a >= MOD ? a - MOD : a;
    }

    static int mod_sub(int a, int b) {
        a -= b;
        return a < 0 ? a + MOD : a;
    }

    static int mod_mul(long a, int b) {
        return (int) ((a * b) % MOD);
    }

    static int mod_pow(int base, int exp) {
        int res = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) res = mod_mul(res, base);
            base = mod_mul(base, base);
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static int comb(int n, int k) {
        return mod_mul((long) fac[n], (long) inv[k] * inv[n - k] % MOD);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        InputReader in = new InputReader(System.in);
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);

        N = in.nextInt();
        M = in.nextInt();
        MOD = in.nextInt();

        fac = new int[N + 1];
        inv = new int[N + 1];
        F = new int[N + 1];
        G = new int[N + 1];
        d1 = new int[N + 1][N + 1][2];
        d2 = new int[N + 1][N + 1][2];

        fac[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i)
            fac[i] = mod_mul(fac[i - 1], i);

        inv[N] = mod_pow(fac[N], MOD - 2);
        for (int i = N; i >= 1; --i)
            inv[i - 1] = mod_mul(inv[i], i);

        F[0] = 0; G[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j) {
                int cur = mod_mul(comb(i - 1, j - 1), i + 1);
                G[i] = mod_add(G[i], mod_mul((long) G[j - 1] * G[i - j] % MOD, cur));
                F[i] = mod_add(F[i], mod_mul((long) F[j - 1] * G[i - j] % MOD, cur));
                F[i] = mod_add(F[i], mod_mul((long) G[j - 1] * F[i - j] % MOD, cur));
                int pt = (j - 1) * j / 2 + (i - j) * (i - j + 1) / 2;
                F[i] = mod_add(F[i], mod_mul((long) comb(i - 1, j - 1) * (long) G[j - 1] % MOD * G[i - j] % MOD, pt));
            }
        }

        d1[0][0][1] = 0;
        d2[0][0][1] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {
                d1[i][j][1] = mod_add(d1[i - 1][j][0], d1[i - 1][j][1]);
                d2[i][j][1] = mod_add(d2[i - 1][j][0], d2[i - 1][j][1]);
                for (int k = 1; k <= j; ++k) {
                    int c = comb(j, k);
                    d1[i][j][0] = mod_add(d1[i][j][0], mod_mul((long) c * d2[i - k][j - k][1] % MOD, F[k]));
                    d1[i][j][0] = mod_add(d1[i][j][0], mod_mul((long) c * d1[i - k][j - k][1] % MOD, G[k]));
                    d2[i][j][0] = mod_add(d2[i][j][0], mod_mul((long) c * d2[i - k][j - k][1] % MOD, G[k]));
                }
            }
        }

        Fout(mod_add(d1[N][M][0], d1[N][M][1]));
        out.flush();
    }

    static class InputReader {
        private InputStream stream;
        private byte[] buf = new byte[1024];
        private int curChar, numChars;

        public InputReader(InputStream stream) {
            this.stream = stream;
        }

        public int read() {
            if (numChars == -1)
                throw new RuntimeException("end of file");
            if (curChar >= numChars) {
                curChar = 0;
                try {
                    numChars = stream.read(buf);
                } catch (IOException e) {
                    throw new RuntimeException(e);
                }
                if (numChars <= 0)
                    return -1;
            }
            return buf[curChar++];
        }

        public int nextInt() {
            int c = read();
            while (isSpaceChar(c))
                c = read();
            int sgn = 1;
            if (c == '-') {
                sgn = -1;
                c = read();
            }
            int res = 0;
            do {
                if (c < '0' || c > '9')
                    throw new InputMismatchException();
                res *= 10;
                res += c - '0';
                c = read();
            } while (!isSpaceChar(c));
            return res * sgn;
        }

        private boolean isSpaceChar(int c) {
            return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1;
        }
    }
}
